title: Use a ferro rod
kid_text: Pull the rod back. A grown-up scrapes.
safety: Sparks can burn skin. Keep your hands behind the rod.

steps.text: Put the rod tip low in the tinder.
Hold the scraper at a steep angle.
A knife spine can be the scraper.
Pull the rod back, not the scraper.
Keep the sparks in the nest.

mistakes.text: You push the scraper into the nest.
You hold the tip up above the nest.
mistakes.fix: Put the tip low in the tinder.
